speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: In the meantime, tenants can continue to alert HDB on areas requiring repair or maintenance, and HDB will attend to these requests promptly.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: My question stems from a desire, maybe from a systemic level, to speed up and to give more allocation and discretion to these officers.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: I see in my rental house visits – and some of us actually have quite a number of them – quite a bit of rusty gates, defective windows, spalling concrete in ceilings due to wear and tear.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: I do not think it is the fault of anybody.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: I thought there is a need to speed up and revive the proactive preventive maintenance programme, and I want to ask if HDB and the Ministry of National Development could look into this.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: Perhaps we could also think of other creative methods, other than just outsourcing to typical vendors, maybe to engage, say, workers from the Yellow Ribbon movement that the Senior Minister of State is also very actively involved with or halfway houses like New Charis Mission – to employ and deploy them so that these preventive maintenance exercises could be revived soon and our residents can live in even better conditions.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: We want to see how the options can be practical and also get collaboration and partnerships with the community organisations.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: There are many good-hearted people, on-the-ground groups, who have reached out proactively to help these tenants.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: So, we will continue to look at some of these options.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: Again, I want to thank the Member for being very proactive and positive in this area.
